summary.intent: Complete the phase 43 (fuse-write-durability) review cycle: run CodeRabbit CLI review, cross-check all 8 existing criticals against current code, fix residuals, run /simplify, capture deferred todos, ship the PR, and resolve open review comments.
summary.outcome: All 8 phase-43 review criticals verified resolved (CR-03 and CR-04 fixed this session), 3 /simplify cleanups applied and 6 deferred items captured as todos, PR #487 created and pushed, sync edge-trigger logic extracted with unit tests, Rust crate coverage wired into codecov, and both CodeRabbit PR threads addressed.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` immediately pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the PR branch — the next local push will be rejected until you `git fetch` + rebase.

codecov was silently discarding all `crates/**` coverage: the `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` job already collects it, but the `desktop` flag's path filter (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**`) dropped crate lines. Adding a second upload under a `rust` flag surfaces the 40 fuse + 43 sdk tests.
The `patch` and `desktop` codecov flags are both `informational: true` — they are advisory and do not block merge.
The winfsp path cannot be compiled on macOS; winfsp edits are CI-only verified via the `--features winfsp` check job.
The branch carried 22 redundant phase-42 commits after main squash-merged PR #485, but the net diff vs `origin/main` was phase-43-only — squash-merge collapses the noise.

Journal dir `<data_local_dir>/cipherbox/cb-journal` and retry count `5` are triplicated across `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/mod.rs`, `fuse/windows/mod.rs`, and `commands/sync.rs` — a CR-07 footgun where sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same directory.
`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` in `windows/write_ops.rs` is a re-export of `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — same function, cosmetic inconsistency but flagged by CodeRabbit as major.
`cargo fmt` should NOT be run on this repo — the codebase is not rustfmt-styled and running it would reformat everything.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: error fallback used `encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default()` in the user-key field — TEE-wrapped key written into the user-wrapped field breaks replay. Fixed to warn+return empty string.

CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE-fallback bug as fuser. Also CR-04: in-memory mutations (inode.kind, pending_content, queue_publish) happened before journal fsync — reordered to after commit point.

CR-03 class: parent IPNS key wrap failure was silently swallowed via `.ok()` → empty key. Hardened to warn-on-failure. Also CR-04: deferred all mutations after journal.put to eliminate phantom-publish risk on prepare failure.
File IPNS key wrap site also had silent empty-string fallback — same pattern as CR-03 class. Hardened uniformly.
Added `JournalOp::created_at_ms()` accessor to eliminate duplicated per-variant sort_by_key match arms in ordered_for_replay.
Dead `journal_entry_id` field in UploadSpawnParams was only assigned and immediately let _-suppressed — removed.

Extracted `bridge_status(prev_failed, current_status)` as a pure function — the edge-trigger anti-spam logic (notify only when failed count increases, reset watermark on Idle) was untestable inline. Now has 8 unit tests.

`is_connected()` gates only the Logout menu item, not Open or Sync. In WriteParked state, the user was authenticated but couldn't log out — fixed by gating Logout on is_connected rather than a more restrictive check.

workflow: 1Password SSH signer can wedge after a failed signing attempt — restart the 1Password app to recover; all staged files survive the failed commit and can be retried without re-staging.
Running parallel read-only agents (one per review critical) significantly speeds up cross-checking a large set of findings against current code.
/simplify and /code-review are complementary passes: code-review hunts correctness bugs, simplify does reuse/efficiency/altitude cleanups — both should be run before shipping.
Deferred /simplify items should be immediately captured as todos with file references and deferral rationale so future sessions have full context.
CodeRabbit re-finding a documented critical (CR-03) in the live code is a reliable signal that commit messages claiming a fix cannot be trusted at face value — always verify against current code.
The Entire pre-push checkpoint hook adds substantial latency to every push; account for this in workflows that chain multiple pushes.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' — required app restart each time, adding multiple retry cycles before the commit landed.
GitHub network connectivity failure (port 443, 75s timeout) on push mid-session — required connectivity check and manual retry.
After `gh pr create`, the bot's immediate `chore(release)` commit caused a rejected push that required `git fetch` + `git rebase` before the next push could land.
winfsp path is not locally compilable on macOS — CR-04 and CR-03 winfsp edits had to be verified by inspection and symmetry with the compile-tested fuser path rather than `cargo check`.
Pre-push Entire hook sync runs on every push and adds significant wall-clock time, making multi-push workflows slow.
Stale local `main` ref caused initial confusion about the real PR diff scope — required computing diff against `origin/main` to confirm phase-42 commits were zero net diff.
open_items: Consolidate duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload+mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods (~150 lines of near-identical drifting code, security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved).

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly plus a `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper — currently inconsistent within a single struct (parent uses sentinel, file uses Option).
Extract shared journal-dir path + `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` constant — triplicated across 3 files, sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same directory (CR-07 footgun).

Have `replay_upload_entry` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a shared `cas_publish_parent` helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70+40 lines that also exist in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs.
Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` — currently re-walks vault tree from root for every replayed entry; super-linear mount-time replay when multiple entries share a parent.
Replace string-matching on 'not found' in replay first-publish detection with a typed error/Option from `resolve_sequence` — a reworded error silently flips the seq-0 vs transient-error branch.

No unit test asserts the CR-04 guarantee ('prepare-failure leaves no partial state') — forcing a `journal.put` failure in a test is difficult; existing replay/park tests pass but don't cover this path.
CR-04 inode rollback for WinFsp is deliberately waived (Cleanup returns VOID, can't signal error) with a code comment — narrow phantom-publish risk remains documented.
Replay code in `lib.rs` has low coverage visible now that the `rust` codecov flag surfaces crate lines — tracked as todos but genuinely network-bound and not unit-testable without mocking.
